headline: Plants vs Zombies - plants that fight back
title: Plants vs Zombies Facts | Sun, Peashooters and Zombies | Classic Games
video_script: Plants versus Zombies came out in two thousand nine from PopCap Games. You defend your house from a zombie apocalypse by planting plants in the lanes of your garden. You collect sun to place them, and if one zombie reaches your house on any lane, you lose. It started on PC and Mac and then came to phones and consoles. Which plant was your favourite? Comment below!
description: Plants vs. Zombies (2009, PopCap Games): a tower defense game where you collect sun to place plants that stop zombies reaching your house.
